text:
kevin: Heads up — main turned red right after the merge from PR #892. CI failed in the inference pipeline
ci-bot: [CI] build/7712 failed: step 'runtime/inference-integration' exit code 1. logs: https://ci.internal/build/7712
maria: @kevin can you paste the failing snippet?
kevin: top error looks like: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.1 GiB` in tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py
alex: I'm starting a rerun now (local + CI)
alex: rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/build/7712/retry
ci-bot: [CI] rerun started (build/7712 retry #1)
sara: pinging @ml-serving @eng-runtime for owner help, marking P0 until we confirm it's scoped to tests or prod impact
kevin: checking recent commits in PR #892 — there was a quantization/kernel selection tweak that touches memory paths
pr-author: hey, that tweak changes kernel selection heuristics only for quantized models, didn't expect OOMs
alex: quick local repro: `pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_persistence -q` repros OOM immediately on my devbox
kevin: can you try running with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` and `--max-memory=16G` in the container to see if it just needs a higher limit?
alex: tried bumping container GPU mem cap from 12G -> 16G, tests then progressed further but still failed later. Looks like a real regression not just env config
maria: if rerun fails we'll need a bisect to find the offending commit. Last green on main was at 1814980000 according to CI history
ci-bot: [CI] rerun completed: failed (build/7712 retry #1)
kevin: rerun failed, starting bisect across commits between 1814980000..1815004321
alex: bisect step 1: checkout 4f2a3 -> tests passed locally
alex: bisect step 2: checkout 9b0c1 -> tests failed (same OOM). Narrowing suggests commit 9b0c1 introduced the regression
kevin: 9b0c1 is part of PR #892 (the quantization tweak). @pr-author can you revert that patch so we can confirm?
pr-author: I can open a revert PR in a few mins
maria: I'll create an expedited revert PR and request CI priority. Also notifying SRE for potential rollback if prod is impacted
sara: filing a short incident note in #incidents with the failed build link and bisect result
maria: Revert PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/901 (revert 9b0c1)
kevin: thanks — @oncall-sre can you watch the revert CI? If it goes green we'll merge and cut a hotfix if needed
oncall-sre: acknowledged, watching the revert PR and ready to assist with rollout
alex: I can validate a quick smoke run after merge to ensure runtime/inference-integration passes
kevin: plan: hold main, merge revert PR if CI green, run smoke, then unfreeze. If revert fails we'll escalate to rollback and incident call
maria: thanks all, will update thread after CI finishes :thumbsup:
